#26. I Wouldn’t Sell It, Not for a Billion Dollars!

📅 17 May 2023 • ⏱️ 11m • 📚 Deep Dive (2212 w)
📖 Baca
Business & Policy ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Aboutislam ↗ Open Full Page

I Wouldn’t Sell It, Not for a Billion Dollars!

📅 17 May 2023 | ⏱️ 11 min read (2212 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Aboutislam

⏱️ ~11 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • My story began about some two years ago now, when I really started to get interested in religion.
  • Besides that, I also always was very interested in things like politics, and current events in the world.
  • On that point, it was obviously not possible to not come in contact with Islam.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

My story began about some two years ago now, when I really started to get interested in religion. I started to get interested, and I think I started a kind of a spiritual search.

Besides that, I also always was very interested in things like politics, and current events in the world.

On that point, it was obviously not possible to not come in contact with Islam. My conversion to Islam comes because of my interest in these 2 things, religion and current events, world politics.

My family was also very religiously involved, my mother had studied theology, and a part of my family is strictly religious. My mother and father though, are not very practicing Christians.

Industry observers note that at first, I didn’t want to know about religion and so I didn’t look to the religious background of my family, I didn’t want to think about it. I lived like a standard teenage boy in the west, drinking alcohol, going to parties, girls and that kind of stuff.

After a little time though, I started to get interested in religion. I think it was also thanks to the many books and religious material in my house and my mother’s books. I started to read the Bible, going to the church and more things that Christians do.

According to recent reports, on vacation in Italy, I really liked all the beautiful religious places. I found it very interesting. But a thing was in me, I didn’t feel perfect in Christianity.

Industry observers note that it’s hard to explain, it was just some kind of feeling. It didn’t feel right, I didn’t think that it was all there was. I just couldn’t feel that this was the perfect religion brought by God.

Besides that, I found it a bit vague in the Bible. I started to learn about the errors of the Bible, I saw it was made for the greatest part by human hands; and I noticed a lot of contradictions.

I just read some of the books of Sheikh Ahmed Deedat, may Allah have mercy on him; I can recommend his books to everyone.

He makes it perfectly clear why the Bible isn’t the Word of God anymore, and tells about Jesus in Islam, and why Jesus wasn’t really God’s son.

I thought this couldn’t be the Message of God, there must be more, God doesn’t put us with nothing but lies in this world!

Sources indicate that further, I started to ask myself the question, why are we here? I think this was one of the main questions that brought me to Islam. The answer that Christianity and atheism gave me was just not satisfying.

According to recent reports, besides that, my other interest, in politics and things that are happening in the world/my country (the Netherlands) brought me to Islam. It was a hot item in the media, everybody speaks about Islam nowadays.

It has been revealed that I wanted to search what Islam really was, instead of just listening to the media, so I started a search by myself. I started to read books about Islam and the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and I found it very inspiring and interesting.

Things like the three in one god of Christianity never seemed good to me. I started to seek more knowledge of Islam. My desire to God grew, I wanted to worship Him, to kneel down for the Almighty!

In a recent development, I found out that a lot of things that the media says about Islam are simply not true. That is a pity. I think people should search for themselves instead of just listening to others.

You will find that Islam is really a beautiful religion with perfect rules and worship to God, that makes you feel great inside yourself, and gives you a feeling of certainty and peace. You should try Islam for yourself!

Also, I found that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was really a great man, a prophet, and I liked the stories of him and his Sahabah (Companions of the Prophet) very much.

What I also liked about Islam is that almost all questions about life, were answered, with clear proofs.

It has been revealed that islam is really an all-embracing religion. It doesn’t make a distinction between religion and everyday life. This is something that I like very much too.

Sources indicate that religion and faith can be found in every aspect of life. With just normal business in life, Muslims trust completely in Allah the Almighty. They first seek help from Him, and just then with people. Here I really found Allah.

My desire to this all-embracing lifestyle became greater and greater. My iman (faith) started to grow real fast. I tried to put my trust in Allah with everything I did. This gave me peace in my heart.

When I wasn’t Muslim, I could get mad or sad about every little thing in life, but Islam taught me that I should not worry about these worldly matters; I only should care about how to gain the pleasure of the Almighty.

In Islam I found real peace, a peace that I couldn’t find in all the other lifestyles I’d surveyed. I was happy no matter what happened.

Things non-Muslims get upset about, for us it’s nothing, we have patience with them, and hope for the reward of our Lord; and maybe He’ll clear us from our sins with the hard things that touch us.

Everything that happens to us is the Fate of Allah, Allah indicates:.

Sources indicate that {And it may be that you dislike a thing which is good for you and that you like a thing which is bad for you. Allah knows but you do not know.} (2: 216).

According to recent reports, in this aya (verse), I see a beautiful part of the most important thing of our religion: tawheed (Oneness of God). We fully submit to God. We listen to Him, and obey Him.

According to recent reports, this verse is also a great answer, I think, to people who say things like ‘this can’t be a rule of Allah, because you can think with your own brain that this is just not right.’ We say, who does know it better, the humans, or God the All-Knowing??? Of course God!

Behind some of His rules we find a hikmah (wisdom), and with others we don’t. But we accept His message fully, because He is the one that knows best what is right and what is wrong.

In a recent development, I, by then, also started to feel connected with the other Muslims all around the world. I started to see it as the community where I was a part of, I started to see other Muslims like my brothers and sisters. I liked the love with them for the sake of Allah.

I found the rules of how to behave and so of Islam, really beautiful and perfect just how it should be to make a peaceful and righteous community. If everybody would hold himself to the rules of Islam, the world would be more beautiful I think, although the enemies of Islam would like us to think the contrary.

I therefore call to all the non-Muslims to search for Islam and see for themselves if Islam is a bad religion. I guarantee you, you would not find what you think!!!

I started to tell my interest in Islam at my own home. It was inevitable that my parents would notice my interest in Islam. We started to discuss many things like religion and so. Though the more I started to get interested in Islam, I started to have more Muslim friends, praying, etc. the more it became difficult.

Recent findings suggest that I even remember a time that my mother came into my room while I was praying. At first she was shocked, and even angry. But later, she accepted it and she even wanted to watch the movie Al-Risalah (The Message) with me.

It has been revealed that the problems got bigger, though I didn’t officially speak out my Shahadah (Testimony of Faith) in the mosque. I just felt like a Muslim, I just had to wait for the right moment to do it.

According to recent reports, I started to pray more, first one time a day, two times, until I prayed five times a day. I spoke with a number of brothers and sisters, and they helped me a lot in the beginning, they got me through it. May Allah reward them all. Ameen.

Eventually, it was the time to speak out my Shahadah in the mosque. I remember I told my mother about it the night before. She didn’t agree with me, and got angry, but the next day I went to the mosque with a couple of brothers. I think my mother doesn’t even know now that I did it, speaking my declaration of faith in a full mosque.

What I can remember of the night before, is that doubt came in to me. Should I do it? Am I sure? Don’t I go too quick? Is this really the right path? Afterwards I can see this had been a big attack by the shaytaan (Satan), who obviously didn’t want me to become a Muslim.

But thanks to Allah, He gave me strength and the next day, in school time I went to the mosque with some brothers. First I went into a room, with the imam of the mosque and other brothers. I talked with them and they were very nice.

According to recent reports, of course it was really scary for me, before a place full of people, almost all with another nationality, to speak my Shahadah. It was beautiful though.

I really felt great, I felt at home out there and I went home with a good feeling, and a lot of books that brothers had bought me.

In a recent development, at first I couldn’t do all my religious duties, I stopped eating pork and drinking alcohol, but the eating of halal meat was a step too far at that time. But after talking that through with my parents they accepted it. Many of these problems got right after all, of course after seeking the help of Allah Almighty.

It has been revealed that there are still a lot of other problems with my parents, like that I don’t want to sit at the table when they are drinking wine or something. I discussed this issue with them, but their reaction was really bad.

I also see that the more religious duties I want to fulfill, the harder it gets. But that is a test of Allah. My parents are intellectual people so discussing with them can be quite hard sometimes.

Sometimes it is really hard with my parents, but I think it is my test I should behave good and show them that Islam is beautiful, because of course they love me, and I love them and I want to enter Paradise Insha’Allah with them. So may Allah give me strength.

All in all, I am now really happy with my upcoming deen (belief). I wouldn’t sell it, not for a billion dollars! The biggest thing again in Islam, what gives me strength is the tawheed, the total and complete submission to God.

This is our only way out, we should not worship or obey anything besides the Almighty. Tawheed is the answer to why we are here, the answer to my question of why are we here?

In Islam, I found the answer in the Quran, it’s very simple and beautiful, in this life and insha’Allah in the Hereafter.

It has been revealed that our life is for Allah, The One who I searched for all that time. Because of that, the best books for me are the ones about tawheed, about our Creator. Because of that I found peace and firmness in my heart.

This was my story of my conversion to Islam. I must have forgotten some things, may Allah forgive me for that.

In concluding I want to say to everyone the importance of Laa ilaaha ilAllah (There is no one worth to be worshipped, except of Allah), because it is the core of our religion, the thing for which we were created, the strongest hold on, the only thing that leads us to Paradise.

In a recent development, if our tawheed isn’t right, Paradise will be forbidden for us, as Allah notes! It’s the only way to Jannah al Firdaus al ‘Ala (The Highest place of Paradise). No one can bring us there except Allah Almighty.

So let’s worship Him with pure worship for Him, to find His Love and Mercy. Let’s seek love and luck with Him, by following the Quran and the Sunnah of our beloved Prophet (peace be upon him).

May Allah forgive me for the mistakes I made in this story; everything good comes from Allah, and everything bad from myself and Satan.

May Allah guide every searcher for the Truth, and make our Ummah (community) one, and guide all my brothers and sisters to Paradise.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

JAKARTA— Rumah tangga Muslim memiliki kedudukan yang sangat agung dalam kehidupan umat. Rumah merupakan tempat lahir dan tumbuhnya generasi penerus, sekaligus tempat mencetak pribadi-pribadi tangguh dan para pejuang. Baca Juga Rasa Takut kepada Allah SWT yang Mulai Hilang Saat Ini, Berikut 9 Perkara untuk Menumbuhkannya Sejak 7 Abad Lalu, Teori Ibnu Khaldun Jelaskan Indikasi Israel Semakin Dekat dengan Kehancuran Orang-Orang Beriman kepada Allah SWT di Sekitar Fir'aun yang Diabadikan Alquran dan Hadis Karena itu, Iblis mengerahkan seluruh pasukannya untuk menyerang rumah tangga. Sebab, rumah adalah gambaran kecil dari sebuah masyarakat. Di dalamnya terdapat suami, istri, para pemuda, dan anak-anak. Semuanya menjadi sasaran godaan Iblis beserta bala tentaranya. Hal ini tergambar jelas dalam sabda Rasulullah SAW: إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ يَضَعُ عَرْشَهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ، ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ سَرَايَاهُ، فَأَدْنَاهُمْ مِنْهُ مَنْزِلَةً أَعْظَمُهُمْ فِتْنَةً، يَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ: فَعَلْتُ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَيَقُولُ: مَا صَنَعْتَ شَيْئًا، قَالَ ثُمَّ يَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ: مَا تَرَكْتُهُ حَتَّى فَرَّقْتُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ امْرَأَتِهِ، قَالَ: فَيُدْنِيهِ مِنْهُ، وَيَقُولُ: نِعْمَ أَنْتَ "Sesungguhnya Iblis meletakkan singgasananya di atas air. Kemudian, ia mengirimkan pasukan-pasukannya. Pasukan yang paling dekat kedudukannya dengan Iblis adalah yang paling besar menimbulkan fitnah. Salah seorang dari mereka datang seraya berkata, 'Aku telah melakukan ini dan itu.' Iblis menjawab, 'Engkau belum melakukan sesuatu yang berarti.' Kemudian, datanglah salah seorang dari mereka seraya berkata, 'Aku tidak meninggalkannya sampai berhasil memisahkan dia dari istrinya.' Iblis pun mendekatkan pasukan tersebut kepadanya dan berkata, 'Engkaulah yang terbaik.'" (HR Muslim). Dalam Syarah Shahih Muslim, Imam an-Nawawi menjelaskan, iblis memujinya karena merasa kagum terhadap perbuatannya dan karena pasukan tersebut telah mencapai tujuan yang diinginkannya. Betapa banyak perceraian terjadi dan rumah tangga hancur hanya karena persoalan-persoalan yang sebenarnya tidak layak menjadi penyebab perpisahan. Ada yang disebabkan karena rumah kurang tertata, masakan terlalu asin atau kurang garam, terlambat menyiapkan hidangan untuk tamu, dan persoalan-persoalan sepele lainnya. Loading... Hal ini tergambar jelas dalam sabda Rasulullah SAW: إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ يَضَعُ عَرْشَهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ، ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ سَرَايَاهُ، فَأَدْنَاهُمْ مِنْهُ مَنْزِلَةً أَعْظَمُهُمْ فِتْنَةً، يَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ: فَعَلْتُ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَيَقُولُ: مَا صَنَعْتَ شَيْئًا، قَالَ ثُمَّ يَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ: مَا تَرَكْتُهُ حَتَّى فَرَّقْتُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ امْرَأَتِهِ، قَالَ: فَيُدْنِيهِ مِنْهُ، وَيَقُولُ: نِعْمَ أَنْتَ "Sesungguhnya Iblis meletakkan singgasananya di atas air. Salah seorang dari mereka datang seraya berkata, 'Aku telah melakukan ini dan itu.' Iblis menjawab, 'Engkau belum melakukan sesuatu yang berarti.' Kemudian, datanglah salah seorang dari mereka seraya berkata, 'Aku tidak meninggalkannya sampai berhasil memisahkan dia dari istrinya.' #23. Industry News: Infertility Struggle: Childless Doesn’t Mean Hopeless

📅 03 Feb 2025 • ⏱️ 3m • 📚 Deep Dive (609 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Aboutislam ↗ Open Full Page

Industry News: Infertility Struggle: Childless Doesn’t Mean Hopeless

📅 03 Feb 2025 | ⏱️ 3 min read (609 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Aboutislam

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Whenever people ask me how you can build a strong marriage without children, I chuckle to myself, wondering how people build strong marriages with children.
  • I imagine my life with children: less sleep, more responsibility, less money, more stress.
  • But then I remember all the stress that comes with infertility.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Whenever people ask me how you can build a strong marriage without children, I chuckle to myself, wondering how people build strong marriages with children.

I imagine my life with children: less sleep, more responsibility, less money, more stress. And I wonder how people keep marriages strong on top of all that.

But then I remember all the stress that comes with infertility. I remember all the times my husband and I were so hopeful that we would bring a child into our family, only to have our dreams dashed time and again.

I remember all my friends whose marriages fell apart after failed fertility treatments.

And I remember so many people believing and telling me and my husband that a woman’s, a man’s, and a marriage’s role in this life is to have children.

So how can people who can’t or don’t have children maintain a strong bond without kids in marital life? This is what I have found to be true:.

The first thing that a couple MUST remember is that our purpose in life is not to have children; this is too far from reality. Our purpose in life is to worship Allah.

{And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.} (Qur’an 51:56).

And, of course, having and raising children, with the right intentions can be one way of doing just that.

But there are so many ways to fulfill our purpose in this life without having children.

There have been many pious people, like Lady Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) and Jesus (peace be upon him), who never had children but still served their purpose in life phenomenally well.

Allah specifically warns us against this kind of approach to life:.

According to recent reports, {O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that – then those are the losers.} (Qur’an 63:9).

The first thing my husband and I remind ourselves of when we get sad about not hearing the bitter patter of little feet running through the house is our true purpose in life.

Industry observers note that this helps both of us refocus on what really matters. And this refocusing is not just helpful in dealing with infertility but with all of life’s let-downs.

After the intense passion of the honeymoon phase is gone, having children gives a husband and a wife a mutual goal and a reason to work together.

But having children is not the only thing that can bring a couple together.

The goal of any marriage should be to help each other gain the pleasure of Allah and attain Jannah together.

But couples can have worldly goals that feed into this ultimate goal.

Childless couples can start saving money to buy a house without interest, or even work together to proposal and build their own home.

They can support each other as they work toward getting advanced degrees or work to further develop their careers.

Recent findings suggest that they can start or join a charity for a cause in which they both believe. They can even help each other learn a newly introduced language or a skill. The options are endless.

Industry observers note that the important thing for me and my husband has been to build a sense of family in our marriage. This is a little harder to do without children, but not impossible.

Our goal orientation in our marriage has helped to create a strong bond just like that of raising children. We call ourselves a team and we act as one.

Tech Report: Rumah Zakat dan Posyandu Melati Putih Gelar Layanan Kesehatan Ibu dan Anak di Malang

📅 17 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 11 min read (2148 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~11 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • MALANG – Rumah Zakat Malang bersama Tim Penggerak Posyandu Melati Putih dan tenaga kesehatan kembali menggelar kegiatan Pos Pelayanan Terpadu (Posyandu) rutin di Balai RW 06, Kelurahan Oro-Oro Dowo, Kota Malang.
  • In a recent development, MALANG – Rumah Zakat Malang bersama Tim Penggerak Posyandu Melati Putih dan tenaga kesehatan kembali menggelar kegiatan Pos Pelayanan Terpadu (Posyandu) rutin di Balai RW 06, Kelurahan Oro-Oro Dowo, Kota Malang.
  • Industry observers note that kegiatan yang berlangsung sejak pagi hari ini mendapat sambutan antusias dari masyarakat.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

MALANG – Rumah Zakat Malang bersama Tim Penggerak Posyandu Melati Putih dan tenaga kesehatan kembali menggelar kegiatan Pos Pelayanan Terpadu (Posyandu) rutin di Balai RW 06, Kelurahan Oro-Oro Dowo, Kota Malang. Kegiatan ini menjadi salah satu upaya meningkatkan kesehatan ibu dan anak sekaligus mendukung pencegahan stunting. Kegiatan yang berlangsung sejak pagi hari ini mendapat sambutan antusias dari masyarakat. Salah satu layanan utama yang diberikan adalah pemantauan tumbuh kembang balita melalui penimbangan berat badan, pengukuran tinggi badan, dan lingkar kepala. Baca Juga Bea Cukai Jember Limpahkan Dua Tersangka dan Barang Bukti Kasus Rokok Ilegal ke Kejaksaan Rumah Zakat Berikan Layanan Kesehatan dan Multivitamin kepada 82 Warga di Malang Peluang Ekspor Produk Lokal Terbuka, Ini Kategori yang Potensial Selain pemeriksaan tersebut, balita juga mendapatkan vitamin dan Pemberian Makanan Tambahan (PMT) bergizi untuk membantu memenuhi kebutuhan nutrisi dan mendukung tumbuh kembang mereka. Rumah Zakat Malang bersama Tim Penggerak Posyandu Melati Putih dan tenaga kesehatan kembali menggelar kegiatan Pos Pelayanan Terpadu (Posyandu) rutin di Balai RW 06, Kelurahan Oro-Oro Dowo, Kota Malang. - (Rumah Zakat)   Ketua Posyandu Melati Putih, Ibu Yenni, menyampaikan bahwa Posyandu memiliki peran penting dalam mendeteksi sejak dini berbagai masalah kesehatan, khususnya pada balita dan ibu hamil. "Kami terus berupaya mengedukasi para orang tua agar konsisten membawa anak-anak mereka ke Posyandu setiap bulan. Pencegahan stunting tidak bisa dilakukan sendiri, melainkan butuh kolaborasi aktif antara tenaga medis, kader Posyandu, dan kepedulian orang tua," ujar Yenni. Tidak hanya melayani balita, kegiatan ini juga menyediakan pemeriksaan kesehatan bagi ibu hamil, meliputi penimbangan berat badan, pengukuran tekanan darah, serta konseling gizi untuk membantu mencegah anemia. Sementara itu, para lansia di lingkungan sekitar turut mendapatkan layanan pemeriksaan kesehatan berupa pengecekan gula darah dan tekanan darah secara gratis. Berdasarkan data kader setempat, tingkat partisipasi masyarakat dalam kegiatan Posyandu kali ini mencapai lebih dari 80 persen dari total sasaran wilayah. Capaian tersebut menunjukkan antusiasme warga dalam memanfaatkan layanan kesehatan yang tersedia. Melalui kolaborasi ini, Rumah Zakat bersama kader Posyandu dan tenaga kesehatan berharap pemantauan kesehatan masyarakat dapat terus berjalan secara rutin. Sinergi berbagai pihak juga diharapkan mampu meningkatkan kesadaran keluarga terhadap pentingnya pemenuhan gizi, pemantauan tumbuh kembang anak, dan pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala. Rumah Zakat Malang bersama Tim Penggerak Posyandu Melati Putih dan tenaga kesehatan kembali menggelar kegiatan Pos Pelayanan Terpadu (Posyandu) rutin di Balai RW 06, Kelurahan Oro-Oro Dowo, Kota Malang. - (Rumah Zakat)   Ketua Posyandu Melati Putih, Ibu Yenni, menyampaikan bahwa Posyandu memiliki peran penting dalam mendeteksi sejak dini berbagai masalah kesehatan, khususnya pada balita dan ibu hamil. "Kami terus berupaya mengedukasi para orang tua agar konsisten membawa anak-anak mereka ke Posyandu setiap bulan. Pencegahan stunting tidak bisa dilakukan sendiri, melainkan butuh kolaborasi aktif antara tenaga medis, kader Posyandu, dan kepedulian orang tua," ujar Yenni. Tidak hanya melayani balita, kegiatan ini juga menyediakan pemeriksaan kesehatan bagi ibu hamil, meliputi penimbangan berat badan, pengukuran tekanan darah, serta konseling gizi untuk membantu mencegah anemia. Sementara itu, para lansia di lingkungan sekitar turut mendapatkan layanan pemeriksaan kesehatan berupa pengecekan gula darah dan tekanan darah secara gratis. Berdasarkan data kader setempat, tingkat partisipasi masyarakat dalam kegiatan Posyandu kali ini mencapai lebih dari 80 persen dari total sasaran wilayah. Capaian tersebut menunjukkan antusiasme warga dalam memanfaatkan layanan kesehatan yang tersedia. Melalui kolaborasi ini, Rumah Zakat bersama kader Posyandu dan tenaga kesehatan berharap pemantauan kesehatan masyarakat dapat terus berjalan secara rutin. Sinergi berbagai pihak juga diharapkan mampu meningkatkan kesadaran keluarga terhadap pentingnya pemenuhan gizi, pemantauan tumbuh kembang anak, dan pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala. Breaking: Telinga Sekilas Seperti Anggota Tubuh Remeh, Padahal Pernahkah Kita Syukuri Nikmat Pendengaran?

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

JAKARTA— Allah SWT melimpahkan begitu banyak nikmat dan karunia kepada hamba-hamba-Nya. Nikmat yang diberikan-Nya tidak terhitung jumlahnya, bahkan tidak ada seorang pun yang mampu menghitung seluruh pemberian-Nya. Di antara nikmat yang begitu agung dan karunia yang sangat besar itu adalah nikmat pendengaran. Dengan pendengaran, manusia dapat menangkap berbagai suara dan membedakan bunyi-bunyian. Baca Juga Rasa Takut kepada Allah SWT yang Mulai Hilang Saat Ini, Berikut 9 Perkara untuk Menumbuhkannya Sejak 7 Abad Lalu, Teori Ibnu Khaldun Jelaskan Indikasi Israel Semakin Dekat dengan Kehancuran Orang-Orang Beriman kepada Allah SWT di Sekitar Fir'aun yang Diabadikan Alquran dan Hadis Pendengaran merupakan karunia yang luar biasa besar. Sejak manusia dilahirkan ke dunia, indra pendengaran telah menyertainya. Pendengaran menjadi salah satu jalan untuk mengenal Sang Pencipta dan ciptaan-Nya, sekaligus menjadi pintu bagi manusia untuk memahami berbagai ilmu pengetahuan dan mengetahui keadaan di sekelilingnya. Allah SWT berfirman: وَاللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ "Allah mengeluarkan kamu dari perut ibumu dalam keadaan tidak mengetahui sesuatu pun dan Dia menjadikan bagi kamu pendengaran, penglihatan, dan hati nurani agar kamu bersyukur." (QS An-Nahl [16]: 78). Allah SWT juga berfirman: ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ "Kemudian Dia menyempurnakannya dan meniupkan roh (ciptaan)-Nya ke dalam (tubuh)-nya dan Dia menjadikan pendengaran, penglihatan, dan hati bagimu, (tetapi) sedikit sekali kamu bersyukur." (QS As-Sajdah [32]: 9). Betapa banyak manfaat yang diperoleh manusia dan bahaya yang dapat dihindarinya melalui nikmat pendengaran ini. Dengannya, manusia dapat mendengar suara-suara petunjuk yang memperbaiki hati dan jiwanya. Dengannya pula, manusia dapat memenuhi kebutuhan hidup dan mengatur berbagai urusan kehidupannya. Pendengaran juga menjadi sarana untuk menenangkan jiwa dan melapangkan dada melalui keindahan berbagai suara, seperti gemericik air, derasnya hujan, deburan ombak, tiupan angin, desiran dedaunan, gerakan ranting pepohonan, merdunya suara burung bulbul, dan kicauan burung-burung kecil. Allah SWT berfirman: وَاللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ "Allah mengeluarkan kamu dari perut ibumu dalam keadaan tidak mengetahui sesuatu pun dan Dia menjadikan bagi kamu pendengaran, penglihatan, dan hati nurani agar kamu bersyukur." (QS An-Nahl [16]: 78). Allah SWT juga berfirman: ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ "Kemudian Dia menyempurnakannya dan meniupkan roh (ciptaan)-Nya ke dalam (tubuh)-nya dan Dia menjadikan pendengaran, penglihatan, dan hati bagimu, (tetapi) sedikit sekali kamu bersyukur." (QS As-Sajdah [32]: 9). Betapa banyak manfaat yang diperoleh manusia dan bahaya yang dapat dihindarinya melalui nikmat pendengaran ini. Dengannya, manusia dapat mendengar suara-suara petunjuk yang memperbaiki hati dan jiwanya. Dengannya pula, manusia dapat memenuhi kebutuhan hidup dan mengatur berbagai urusan kehidupannya. Pendengaran juga menjadi sarana untuk menenangkan jiwa dan melapangkan dada melalui keindahan berbagai suara, seperti gemericik air, derasnya hujan, deburan ombak, tiupan angin, desiran dedaunan, gerakan ranting pepohonan, merdunya suara burung bulbul, dan kicauan burung-burung kecil. #19. Does Reliance on Allah Contradict Self-Confidence?

📅 17 Nov 2019 • ⏱️ 2m • 📖 Standard (477 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Aboutislam ↗ Open Full Page

Does Reliance on Allah Contradict Self-Confidence?

📅 17 Nov 2019 | ⏱️ 2 min read (477 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Aboutislam

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Self-confidence is borne from the Believer’s intimate knowledge and understanding that Allah is ever ready to assist those who strive and struggle in His way.
  • Self-confidence comes from depending upon Allah; from knowing that He is there to help you, protect you and shower His mercies upon you:.
  • {So he who gives [in charity] and fears [Allah] and [in all sincerity] testifies to the best- We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.}  (Al-Layl 92: 5-7).
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Self-confidence is borne from the Believer’s intimate knowledge and understanding that Allah is ever ready to assist those who strive and struggle in His way.

Self-confidence comes from depending upon Allah; from knowing that He is there to help you, protect you and shower His mercies upon you:.

{So he who gives [in charity] and fears [Allah] and [in all sincerity] testifies to the best- We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.}  (Al-Layl 92: 5-7).

Self-confidence also emanates from knowing that Allah in His infinite mercy has equipped you with all that you require to undertake the tasks set before you. z.

It is not characteristic of the One who is Most Just and Most Merciful to prepare you for a duel without equipping you with the necessary tools.

It has been revealed that self-confidence is thus borne of total reliance and trust in Allah. It is knowing that at every step of your journey, Allah is there assisting you.

So, if you constantly hold yourself back believing that you are weak and incapable and blame your incompetence on minor inadequacies, then you are bound to fail.

You must never allow yourself to believe or feel that Allah has treated you unfairly or that He has placed upon you a burden you cannot shoulder for {on no soul does Allah place a burden greater than it can bear.} (Al-Baqarah 2: 286).

Likewise, hope is central to your efforts and your success. You must sincerely hope and believe that everything you do to earn the pleasure of Allah will lead you to fulfillment.

A superiority complex negates the task of self-development (Tazkiyah). An inferiority complex is derived from a lack of confidence in Allah and oneself.

According to recent reports, you should never allow yourself to believe that you cannot fulfill your obligations nor should you despair of the mercy of Allah. Confidence, hope and determination are all important ingredients for your success:.

{Those unto whom men stated: Lo! the people have gathered against you, therefore fear them. But it only increased them in faith and they cried: Allah is sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust!} (Aal `Imran 3: 173).

Recent findings suggest that you must be wary, however, of the kind of self-confidence that causes a person to claim self-sufficiency. Modern concepts of self-sufficiency are indeed an evil form of shirk or polytheism. To ascribe self-sufficiency to one’s self is to assume for oneself an attribute reserved only for Allah.

According to recent reports, for the Muslim, self-confidence is wholly dependent upon the trust one places in Allah; it is not an arrogant proclamation of complete independence from Allah. Allah alone is self-Sufficient. All else is reliant upon Him for existence.

Source: Khurram Murad’s book “In the Early Hours: Reflections on Spiritual and Self”.

ICMI Muda Banten Tolak Relokasi Badak Jawa dari Ujung Kulon, Ini Alasannya

📅 18 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 25 min read (5061 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~25 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • BANTEN -- Ikatan Cendekiawan Muslim Indonesia (ICMI) Muda Provinsi Banten menyatakan keberatan terhadap wacana pemindahan Badak Jawa (Rhinoceros sondaicus) dari Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon, Kabupaten Pandeglang, Banten ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Jawa Timur.
  • BANTEN -- Ikatan Cendekiawan Muslim Indonesia (ICMI) Muda Provinsi Banten menyatakan keberatan terhadap wacana pemindahan Badak Jawa (Rhinoceros sondaicus) dari Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon, Kabupaten Pandeglang, Banten ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Jawa Timur.
  • BANTEN -- Ikatan Cendekiawan Muslim Indonesia (ICMI) Muda Provinsi Banten menyatakan keberatan terhadap wacana pemindahan Badak Jawa (Rhinoceros sondaicus) dari Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon, Kabupaten Pandeglang, Banten ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Jawa Timur.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

BANTEN -- Ikatan Cendekiawan Muslim Indonesia (ICMI) Muda Provinsi Banten menyatakan keberatan terhadap wacana pemindahan Badak Jawa (Rhinoceros sondaicus) dari Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon, Kabupaten Pandeglang, Banten ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Jawa Timur. Baca Juga Portugal Kalahkan Wales 3-2, Carlos Forbs Jadi Penentu Kemenangan di Cardiff Habitat Kedua Badak Jawa Harus Dikaji Berbasis Sains, Status Ujung Kulon tak Boleh Dilemahkan Program Penjaminan Polis Dimulai 2028, OJK dan LPS Siapkan Pertukaran Data Wakil Ketua ICMI Muda Provinsi Banten, Sahrul Hikam menilai rencana tersebut perlu mendapat perhatian serius karena menyangkut keberlangsungan hidup salah satu spesies paling langka di dunia yang habitat alami terakhirnya berada di Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon. Menurutnya, Ujung Kulon bukan sekadar kawasan konservasi di Provinsi Banten, melainkan habitat alami terakhir Badak Jawa di dunia sekaligus warisan ekologis yang memiliki arti penting bagi Indonesia maupun masyarakat internasional. “Kami dari ICMI Muda Provinsi Banten secara tegas menyatakan keberatan terhadap wacana pemindahan Badak Jawa dari Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo,” kata Hikam kepada Republika, Rabu (18/11/2026) Ia menegaskan, kebijakan konservasi tidak boleh hanya dibangun di atas asumsi mitigasi bencana, tetapi harus didasarkan pada kajian ilmiah yang komprehensif, terukur, dan dapat dipertanggungjawabkan. Menurutnya, upaya mengantisipasi ancaman bencana terhadap populasi Badak Jawa memang merupakan hal penting. Namun, langkah yang diambil pemerintah juga harus memperhitungkan risiko ekologis dan biologis yang mungkin timbul akibat proses pemindahan satwa tersebut. “Jangan sampai kebijakan yang dimaksudkan untuk menyelamatkan justru menciptakan risiko baru terhadap kelangsungan hidup spesies tersebut,” ujarnya. ICMI Muda Provinsi Banten, persoalan konservasi Badak Jawa tidak semestinya hanya dilihat dari pilihan memindahkan atau mempertahankan satwa di suatu kawasan, melainkan bagaimana negara memastikan keberlangsungan hidup spesies tersebut melalui kebijakan yang tepat dan berbasis ilmu pengetahuan. “Bagi kami, menyelamatkan Badak Jawa tidak harus dimulai dengan memindahkannya, tetapi harus dimulai dengan memastikan rumah alaminya benar-benar terlindungi,” ujarnya. Untuk itu, Hikam meminta Pemerintah Provinsi Banten dan Pemerintah Kabupaten Pandeglang untuk segera mengambil sikap yang jelas dan tegas terhadap wacana tersebut. Menurutnya, pemerintah daerah tidak boleh bersikap pasif ketika masa depan salah satu warisan ekologis terpenting di wilayahnya sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Ia juga menilai bahwa berbagai keberatan yang telah disampaikan oleh tokoh masyarakat, organisasi lingkungan, dan elemen masyarakat setempat seharusnya menjadi pertimbangan serius bagi pemerintah daerah untuk menyampaikan aspirasi dan memperjuangkan kepentingan konservasi Ujung Kulon. “Kami meminta Pemerintah Provinsi Banten dan Pemerintah Kabupaten Pandeglang segera menyampaikan sikap resmi dan mengambil langkah konkret. Jangan sampai pemerintah daerah terlambat merespons persoalan yang menyangkut masa depan kawasan konservasi dan identitas ekologis Banten,” ujarnya. Hikam menegaskan, upaya penyelamatan Badak Jawa harus ditempatkan sebagai kepentingan bersama yang melampaui batas administratif maupun kepentingan sektoral. Karena itu, pemerintah pusat, pemerintah daerah, akademisi, pakar konservasi, organisasi masyarakat sipil, serta masyarakat sekitar kawasan perlu dilibatkan dalam setiap proses pengambilan kebijakan. “Konservasi harus mengedepankan tanggung jawab ilmiah, keberlanjutan ekosistem, dan kepentingan generasi mendatang. Badak Jawa adalah kekayaan hayati Indonesia yang harus kita jaga bersama,” kata Wakil Ketua ICMI Muda Provinsi Banten.

Menurutnya, upaya mengantisipasi ancaman bencana terhadap populasi Badak Jawa memang merupakan hal penting. Namun, langkah yang diambil pemerintah juga harus memperhitungkan risiko ekologis dan biologis yang mungkin timbul akibat proses pemindahan satwa tersebut.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

JAKARTA -- Kementerian Haji dan Umrah (Kemenhaj) menyatakan transformasi sistem penyelenggaraan haji 1448 H/2027 M yang dilakukan Arab Saudi menuntut kesiapan dan pola kerja baru dari seluruh Petugas Penyelenggara Ibadah Haji (PPIH). Direktur Jenderal Bina Haji Kementerian Haji dan Umrah Puji Raharjo menegaskan, petugas tidak hanya dituntut memahami perubahan sistem layanan, tetapi juga harus responsif dan mampu memastikan seluruh kebutuhan jamaah terpenuhi. Recent findings suggest that JAKARTA -- Imam Syafii dikenal sebagai salah satu imam empat mazhab. Mazhabnya disebut dengan mazhab Syafii. Ajarannya tersebar luas di beberapa negara. Khususnya, di Asia Tenggara. Dikutip dari Abdul Aziz Asy Syinawi dalam Biografi Empat Mazhab, disebutkan nasab Imam Syafii bertemu dengan Rasulullah SAW. Beliau adalah Muhammad bin Idris bin Abbas bin Utsman bin Syafi bin Saib bin UBaid bin Abdi Yazid bin Hasyim bin Abdul Muttalib bin Abdul Manaf Al Quraisy (Berkebangsaan QUraisy) Al Muttalibi (keturunan ABdul Muthalib) As Syafii. Baca Juga Siapa Lebih Utama Utsman bin Affan atau Ali bin Abi Thalib Menurut Imam Hanafi? Alasan Imam Al-Ghazali Sebut Ilmu Lebih Utama daripada Ibadah tanpa Ilmu Imam Mahdi Madura Peras Jamaah Rp 1,3 Miliar, MUI Jatim: Hati-hati, Perbanyak Konsultasi ke Ulama Nasab beliau bertemu dengan Rasulullah SAW pada kakek beliau, Abdul Manaf, dan silsilaf nasab beliau selanjutnya sampai kepada Adnan. Kakek beliau, Syafi', bertemu dengan Rasulullah SAW ketika Rasulullah masih kecil. Sedangkan bapaknya, Sa'ib, adalah pembawa bendera Bani Hasyim dalam perang Badar, lalu ia tertawan dan menebus dirinya, kemudian masuk Islam. Setelah itu ada yang bertanya kepadanya, "Kenapa kamu tidak masuk ISlam sebelum kamu menebus dirimu?" Ia menjawab, "Karena aku tidak ingin menghalangi makanan milik kaum Mukminin yang ada padaku." Ibu Imam Syafii berasal dari kabilah Azd. Ada yang mengatakan, "Dia adalah Fathimah binti Abdillah bin Husain bin Ali bin Abu THalib sehingga ia adalah wanita berkebangsaan QUraisy. " Ada yang berpendapat, "Sesungguhnya ibunda Imam Syafii beradal dari kabilah Azd." Dan nasab dari bapaknya sudah cukup menjadikan beliau disebut sebagai keturunan QUraisy." 💡 Key Takeaways
  • It has been revealed that JAKARTA - Sekretaris Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI) Provinsi Banten, Dr.
  • JAKARTA - Sekretaris Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI) Provinsi Banten, Dr.
  • Recent findings suggest that rozak menegaskan, sikap penolakan tersebut ia sampaikan dalam kapasitas pribadi serta sebagai tokoh masyarakat Tangerang Selatan, Banten.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that JAKARTA - Sekretaris Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI) Provinsi Banten, Dr. H. Abdul Rozak, MA, menyatakan penolakannya terhadap wacana pemindahan sebagian populasi badak jawa (Rhinoceros sondaicus) dari Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon (TNUK), Kabupaten Pandeglang, ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Jawa Timur. Rozak menegaskan, sikap penolakan tersebut ia sampaikan dalam kapasitas pribadi serta sebagai tokoh masyarakat Tangerang Selatan, Banten. Ia menilai rencana relokasi satwa langka yang menjadi ikon daerahnya itu belum memiliki urgensi yang kuat. Baca Juga Uni Eropa Ketar-Ketir Lawan Dominasi China di Mobil Listrik dan Panel Surya Badan Jalan di Pasar Minggu Dipenuhi PKL, Pedagang Mengaku tak Laku Berjualan di Lokasi Binaan Pemkab Karawang Sabet Penghargaan Anti Kecurangan Layanan Kesehatan "Secara pribadi dan atas nama tokoh masyarakat Tangsel, Banten, saya menolak pemindahan badak jawa ke Alas Purwo," ujar Rozak saat dihubungi Republika, Rabu (18/11/2026). Meski demikian, Rozak mengungkapkan bahwa persoalan ini akan segera dibawa ke ranah kelembagaan. Komisi Fatwa MUI Banten dijadwalkan menggelar rapat khusus dalam waktu dekat untuk merumuskan dan mengeluarkan fatwa resmi terkait polemik pemindahan satwa endemik tersebut. "Secara detail MUI Banten akan membahas dan mengeluarkan fatwa terkait pemindahan badak jawa ini. Dalam waktu dekat akan dibahas di Komisi Fatwa karena menyangkut wilayah Banten, dilihat dari berbagai macam sisi dan perspektif," kata Rozak. Ia menjelaskan, kajian fatwa tersebut akan menimbang aspek kemaslahatan dan keselamatan keberlangsungan populasi badak jawa. Menurutnya, langkah pemindahan yang berpotensi mendatangkan kerugian atau risiko kematian bagi satwa harus ditinjau secara ketat dalam kaidah hukum Islam. "Dalam bahasa agama, belum ada illat yang mengharuskan satwa itu dipindahkan. Sekiranya pemindahan itu akan banyak menimbulkan mudarat karena belum tentu di sana bisa dijamin keberlangsungan keselamatannya, tentu tidak boleh," tuturnya. Kendati pembahasan fatwa segera bergulir, Rozak menggarisbawahi bahwa pernyataan penolakannya saat ini belum mewakili keputusan formal lembaga. Sikap kelembagaan baru berlaku setelah produk hukum agama tersebut resmi diterbitkan. "Jangan dulu dibawa atas nama lembaga MUI Banten karena fatwanya belum keluar. Nanti kalau sudah resmi keluar fatwanya, itu baru atas nama lembaga. Kalau saat ini baru bersifat pandangan pribadi saya," pungkasnya. Sebelumnya diberitakan, pemerintah mewacanakan pemindahan sebagian badak Jawa ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Banyuwangi, dengan alasan ancaman bencana. Namun, di sisi lain, perairan sekitar Ujung Kulon justru ditetapkan sebagai Wilayah Usaha Pertambangan (WUP). Ikuti Whatsapp Channel Republika.

JAKARTA - Sekretaris Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI) Provinsi Banten, Dr. H. Abdul Rozak, MA, menyatakan penolakannya terhadap wacana pemindahan sebagian populasi badak jawa (Rhinoceros sondaicus) dari Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon (TNUK), Kabupaten Pandeglang, ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Jawa Timur.

Recent findings suggest that rozak menegaskan, sikap penolakan tersebut ia sampaikan dalam kapasitas pribadi serta sebagai tokoh masyarakat Tangerang Selatan, Banten. Ia menilai rencana relokasi satwa langka yang menjadi ikon daerahnya itu belum memiliki urgensi yang kuat. Baca Juga Uni Eropa Ketar-Ketir Lawan Dominasi China di Mobil Listrik dan Panel Surya Badan Jalan di Pasar Minggu Dipenuhi PKL, Pedagang Mengaku tak Laku Berjualan di Lokasi Binaan Pemkab Karawang Sabet Penghargaan Anti Kecurangan Layanan Kesehatan "Secara pribadi dan atas nama tokoh masyarakat Tangsel, Banten, saya menolak pemindahan badak jawa ke Alas Purwo," ujar Rozak saat dihubungi Republika, Rabu (18/11/2026). Meski demikian, Rozak mengungkapkan bahwa persoalan ini akan segera dibawa ke ranah kelembagaan. Komisi Fatwa MUI Banten dijadwalkan menggelar rapat khusus dalam waktu dekat untuk merumuskan dan mengeluarkan fatwa resmi terkait polemik pemindahan satwa endemik tersebut. "Secara detail MUI Banten akan membahas dan mengeluarkan fatwa terkait pemindahan badak jawa ini. Dalam waktu dekat akan dibahas di Komisi Fatwa karena menyangkut wilayah Banten, dilihat dari berbagai macam sisi dan perspektif," kata Rozak. Ia menjelaskan, kajian fatwa tersebut akan menimbang aspek kemaslahatan dan keselamatan keberlangsungan populasi badak jawa. Menurutnya, langkah pemindahan yang berpotensi mendatangkan kerugian atau risiko kematian bagi satwa harus ditinjau secara ketat dalam kaidah hukum Islam. "Dalam bahasa agama, belum ada illat yang mengharuskan satwa itu dipindahkan. Sekiranya pemindahan itu akan banyak menimbulkan mudarat karena belum tentu di sana bisa dijamin keberlangsungan keselamatannya, tentu tidak boleh," tuturnya. Kendati pembahasan fatwa segera bergulir, Rozak menggarisbawahi bahwa pernyataan penolakannya saat ini belum mewakili keputusan formal lembaga. Sikap kelembagaan baru berlaku setelah produk hukum agama tersebut resmi diterbitkan. "Jangan dulu dibawa atas nama lembaga MUI Banten karena fatwanya belum keluar. Nanti kalau sudah resmi keluar fatwanya, itu baru atas nama lembaga. Kalau saat ini baru bersifat pandangan pribadi saya," pungkasnya. Sebelumnya diberitakan, pemerintah mewacanakan pemindahan sebagian badak Jawa ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Banyuwangi, dengan alasan ancaman bencana. Namun, di sisi lain, perairan sekitar Ujung Kulon justru ditetapkan sebagai Wilayah Usaha Pertambangan (WUP). Ikuti Whatsapp Channel Republika.

#11. Industry News: Happiness Awaits the Patient

📅 15 Sep 2016 • ⏱️ 7m • 📚 Deep Dive (1369 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Aboutislam ↗ Open Full Page

Industry News: Happiness Awaits the Patient

📅 15 Sep 2016 | ⏱️ 7 min read (1369 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Aboutislam

⏱️ ~7 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • In Part 1, we discussed the virtues of having patience, as well as some of the various ways we must exert patience, and why.
  • We discussed having patience while practicing the deen, when faced with crisis, with jobs, finances, and anger.
  • We will continue further examining other ways we must use patience in our daily lives.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In Part 1, we discussed the virtues of having patience, as well as some of the various ways we must exert patience, and why.

We discussed having patience while practicing the deen, when faced with crisis, with jobs, finances, and anger.

We will continue further examining other ways we must use patience in our daily lives.

In Conflicts with Others (Friends, Family, Strangers).

Rather than reaching out and strangling the person that is irritating you, hold back, and remind yourself that Allah rewards the patient one, and watches over all things.

As long as you are pleasing Allah, no one can cause any harm (physically or mentally) to you if it is not His will.

{If aught that is good befalls you, it grieves them; but if some misfortune overtakes you, they rejoice at it. But if ye are constant and do right, not the least harm will their cunning do to you; for Allah compasseth round about all that they do.} (3:120).

If someone is treating you in a poor manner, don’t return it to them with the same behavior. Remain patient and return with kindness and you may be amazed at how things can turn around. Don’t fuel the fire and drop to their level by acting the same way. You may find them to be a loyal friend in the end.

Sources indicate that put your trust in Allah. When Allah is on your side, nobody or anything can harm you unless it was prescribed to you as a test.

In a recent development, “And know that if the nation were to gather together to benefit you with anything, they would not benefit you except with what Allah had already prescribed for you. And if they were to gather together to harm you with anything, they would not harm you except with what Allah had already prescribed against you. The pens have been lifted and the pages have dried.” (An-Nawawi, 19).

An example being, when a person finds out it is not allowed to drink alcohol or have sexual relations outside marriage, this person tries his utmost best to refrain from these things, even if they have the urge to do so.

In a recent development, when one is afflicted with something due to having committed sinful acts, such as illness or a disease, this would be a punishment from Allah. Avoid sins as much as possible to avoid the consequences, and repent and ask for forgiveness. Otherwise you will face the punishment in the hereafter which would be much worse.

Obtain happiness by remaining calm and patient when faced with such matters. When you obey the commands of Allah, He will bless you with something better!

When Giving Dawah to a Friend or Relative.

Do you have someone in your life that is hesitant to hear, read, or learn anything about Islam?

Sources indicate that when it comes to friends or family it can really be a test of patience because they may insult you, Islam, the Quran, or even Allah. It is a long road but be patient to reach the final destination.

Patience is a requirement in these situations and you must display the ideal behavior of a Muslim. Do not resort to returning insults or yelling, or fighting over matters. You will never get through to them if they see a negative attitude from you. Over time they may open their hearts and minds, but you must have patience, patience, and more patience!!!

Sources indicate that marriage is about compromise and learning to forgive one another, and most importantly – having patience in times of disputes. It is easier stated than done, but this is the key to a successful marriage. So, next time you argue over household chores, or financial matters, or the stresses that in-laws bring, look over it and forgive. Choose your battles wisely to have a loving relationship minus constant tension.

Sources indicate that patience does not mean to suffer in silence either! If you are abused, you have the option to divorce in Islam. The Prophet mentioned:.

Industry observers note that “When a person suffers from a calamity and utters: ‘Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji’un. Allahumma ujurni fi musibati, wakhluf li khairan minha (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. O Allah! Compensate me in my affliction, recompense my loss and give me something better in exchange for it), then Allah surely compensates him with reward and a better substitute.” (Muslim, 918).

When Umm Salama made this du’a, after her husband died, she found herself married to the Prophet (peace be upon him)! Divorce is not the end of the world as you may know it to be. There is life after divorce, and an opportunity for a happy one at that!

O’ the joys of parenthood! Children can test your patience as if it was their only purpose for their existence…. especially in their teens.

Raise your children with a solid foundation for life based on Islamic teachings with patience and Insha’Allah, they will be respectful, pious, and a comfort to your nerves.

Industry observers note that when children are acting up, keep your cool, have patience, and treat them how you would like to be treated with respect and honor, and they will cause you less stress when they see you respect them even though they are younger than you. Nothing beats having a happy home filled with the joys of having respectful children, but you have to give it to earn it in return.

Desires for Something in the Dunya.

“…By Allah, I do not fear poverty for you, rather I fear that you will enjoy ease and plenty like those who came before you, and that you will compete with one another as they did, and you will be destroyed as they were.”  (Ibn Majah, 5).

Are you caught up in the desires of this world?

Having trouble “keeping up with the Khans”?

When you are caught up in this cycle of always desiring something better, remind yourself that to earn the rewards of Allah, you must turn away from this type of thinking and remain patient for the rewards for your steadfastness in the hereafter.

Did you know that the most affluent of people in this world will be dipped in the fire and the most destitute will be dipped in Paradise?

On the Day of Judgment, mankind will be told:.

“O, son of Adam, did you find any comfort, did you happen to get any material blessing? He would say: By Allah, no, my Lord. And then that person from amongst the persons of the world be brought who had led the most miserable life (in the world) from amongst the inmates of Paradise, and he would be made to dip once in Paradise and it would be said to him. O, son of Adam, did you face, any hardship? Or had any distress fallen to your lot? And he would say: By Allah, no, O’ my Lord, never did I face any hardship or experience any distress.” (Muslim, 2807).

Sources indicate that patience is a foundation of faith. If you lack patience, you are lacking faith.

New Muslims must exert a lot of patience when they accept Islam, because they will face many trials and tribulations, and if lacking patience, one may be tempted to leave Islam and they will lose in this life and the hereafter:.

In a recent development, {And among mankind is he who worships Allah as it were, upon the very edge (i.e. in doubt); if good befalls him, he is content therewith; but if a trial befalls him, he turns back on his face (i.e. reverts back to disbelief after embracing Islam). He loses both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss.} (22:11).

In a recent development, “…He who remains patient, Allah will bestow patience upon him, and he who is satisfied with what he has, Allah will make him self-sufficient. And there is no gift better and vast (you may be given) than patience.”   (Al-Bukhari, 6470).

May Allah grant all of us patience in the world to earn the pleasures of the hereafter.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, JEDDAH - Pusat Meteorologi Nasional Arab Saudi (National Center for Meteorology/NCM) meningkatkan status peringatan ke level siaga merah untuk wilayah Makkah menyusul cuaca ekstrem yang melanda sejumlah kawasan Kerajaan. Hujan lebat disertai badai petir dan angin kencang terus menerjang berbagai wilayah dalam beberapa hari terakhir. Dilansir dari Saudi Gazette, Rabu (18/11/2026), NCM mengeluarkan peringatan siaga merah untuk sebagian wilayah Makkah yang berlaku mulai pukul 12.00 hingga 21.00 waktu setempat. Otoritas memperingatkan potensi cuaca berbahaya berupa angin kencang, jarak pandang horizontal yang mendekati nol, hujan es, potensi banjir bandang (flash floods), serta sambaran petir. Baca Juga MUI Banten Siapkan Fatwa soal Wacana Pemindahan Badak Ujung Kulon Mensos Respons Kontroversi Rencana Sekolah Rakyat di UI: Bukan di Hutan Kota Uni Eropa Ketar-Ketir Lawan Dominasi China di Mobil Listrik dan Panel Surya Selain status siaga merah, sebagian wilayah lain di Makkah juga berada dalam status siaga oranye untuk curah hujan dengan intensitas sedang dalam rentang waktu yang sama. Kondisi serupa turut diwaspadai di wilayah Asir, di mana status siaga oranye diberitakan berlaku sejak pukul 09.00 hingga 20.00 malam. Berdasarkan prakiraan cuaca nasional NCM, badai petir dengan intensitas sedang hingga lebat yang disertai angin aktif dan hujan es diprediksi masih akan terus berlangsung di sejumlah wilayah, termasuk Jazan, Asir, Al-Baha, dan Makkah. Kondisi ini berisiko memicu meluapnya aliran air di berbagai titik rawan. Selain ancaman banjir bandang dan petir, pihak otoritas meteorologi juga mengingatkan potensi kabut tebal yang dapat mengganggu jarak pandang di wilayah-wilayah tersebut, serta di sepanjang kawasan pesisir Provinsi Timur (Eastern Province). Masyarakat, khususnya para jamaah serta warga yang beraktivitas di sekitar Dua Tanah Suci (Haramain) dan sekitarnya, diimbau untuk senantiasa meningkatkan kewaspadaan, mematuhi arahan keselamatan dari pihak berwenang, serta mengantisipasi potensi gangguan perjalanan akibat cuaca ekstrem ini. Sumber: Saudi Gazette   Ikuti Whatsapp Channel Republika.

Tech Report: Sekretaris MUI Banten Nilai Relokasi Badak Jawa Belum Mendesak

📅 18 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 9 min read (1831 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~9 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • JAKARTA - Sekretaris Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI) Provinsi Banten, Dr.
  • JAKARTA - Sekretaris Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI) Provinsi Banten, Dr.
  • Menurut Rozak, keberhasilan menjaga populasi satwa langka yang menjadi simbol kebanggaan masyarakat Banten tersebut merupakan buah dari sinergi yang baik antara pemerintah daerah dan kesadaran warga setempat.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

JAKARTA - Sekretaris Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI) Provinsi Banten, Dr. H. Abdul Rozak, MA, mengajak semua pihak untuk menjaga harmoni ekosistem yang telah terbangun di Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon (TNUK), Kabupaten Pandeglang. Ia menilai wacana pemindahan sebagian populasi badak jawa (Rhinoceros sondaicus) ke Taman Nasional Alas Purwo, Jawa Timur, belum memiliki urgensi yang mendesak karena habitat aslinya terbukti aman dan lestari. Menurut Rozak, keberhasilan menjaga populasi satwa langka yang menjadi simbol kebanggaan masyarakat Banten tersebut merupakan buah dari sinergi yang baik antara pemerintah daerah dan kesadaran warga setempat. Ekosistem di Ujung Kulon dinilai terjaga dari praktik pembalakan liar maupun perambahan yang merusak lingkungan. Baca Juga MUI Banten Siapkan Fatwa soal Wacana Pemindahan Badak Ujung Kulon Mensos Respons Kontroversi Rencana Sekolah Rakyat di UI: Bukan di Hutan Kota Uni Eropa Ketar-Ketir Lawan Dominasi China di Mobil Listrik dan Panel Surya "Selama ini satwa itu sangat diurus dan diperhatikan oleh Pemerintah Kabupaten Pandeglang serta Pemerintah Provinsi Banten untuk perkembangan dan kehidupannya. Di sana sudah berada di daerah yang sangat aman, nyaman, dan betul-betul dilindungi," ujar Rozak saat dihubungi Republika, Rabu (18/11/2026). Rozak mengingatkan agar upaya pelestarian satwa tetap menghormati hukum keseimbangan alam. Perbedaan karakteristik geografis dan lingkungan di Alas Purwo dikhawatirkan justru memicu ketidakcocokan adaptasi yang berdampak buruk bagi keberlangsungan hidup badak jawa. "Belum tentu kalau dipindahkan ke sana alamnya cocok dengan badak jawa. Faktor alam dan suasananya berbeda. Kami khawatir jika pemindahan tetap terjadi, malah menimbulkan banyak kematian karena tidak cocok dengan kehidupan badak jawa," kata tokoh masyarakat Tangerang Selatan tersebut. Menanggapi pertimbangan pemerintah bahwa relokasi diperlukan sebagai langkah antisipasi kepunahan akibat potensi bencana alam seperti tsunami atau erupsi gunung berapi, Rozak memandang kekhawatiran tersebut perlu ditinjau ulang secara proporsional. Ia merujuk pada pengalaman penanganan erupsi Gunung Anak Krakatau di Selat Sunda sebelumnya yang berhasil dilalui tanpa menimbulkan korban pada populasi badak. "Selama ini ketika terjadi erupsi Krakatau atau Anak Krakatau, satwa itu tetap terjaga, dipantau, dan dilindungi. Tidak ada korban, keselamatannya tetap diprioritaskan oleh pihak Provinsi Banten dan Kabupaten Pandeglang. Jadi alasan kekhawatirannya itu tidak mendasar," tuturnya. Menutup pernyataannya, ia berharap kebijakan konservasi ke depan tetap berpijak pada kemaslahatan satwa serta menghargai kearifan lokal masyarakat Banten yang selama ini hidup berdampingan menjaga kelestarian Ujung Kulon. Ikuti Whatsapp Channel Republika.

"Selama ini ketika terjadi erupsi Krakatau atau Anak Krakatau, satwa itu tetap terjaga, dipantau, dan dilindungi. Tidak ada korban, keselamatannya tetap diprioritaskan oleh pihak Provinsi Banten dan Kabupaten Pandeglang. Jadi alasan kekhawatirannya itu tidak mendasar," tuturnya. Menutup pernyataannya, ia berharap kebijakan konservasi ke depan tetap berpijak pada kemaslahatan satwa serta menghargai kearifan lokal masyarakat Banten yang selama ini hidup berdampingan menjaga kelestarian Ujung Kulon. #7. Muslim Teenagers Tired of Parents’ ‘Unfair Judgments’

📅 25 Nov 2021 • ⏱️ 4m • 📚 Deep Dive (870 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Aboutislam ↗ Open Full Page

Muslim Teenagers Tired of Parents’ ‘Unfair Judgments’

📅 25 Nov 2021 | ⏱️ 4 min read (870 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Aboutislam

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • I’ve never met a parent who claims to fully understand how to raise their teenager.
  • Often what tips parents over the edge is when their child behaves in a manner that conflicts with the religious values parents work to provide their children with.
  • In a recent development, these actions feel like betrayals to the parent though the child’s motives are rarely malicious.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

I’ve never met a parent who claims to fully understand how to raise their teenager. It’s normal and expected for teens to commit small, relatively harmless acts of rebellion.

Often what tips parents over the edge is when their child behaves in a manner that conflicts with the religious values parents work to provide their children with.

In a recent development, these actions feel like betrayals to the parent though the child’s motives are rarely malicious. Muslim teenagers explain why they are tired of being unfairly judged by their parents.

Muslim-American teenagers offered insight about how their parents handle the daunting task of instilling their own religious values.

My own stance on religious parenting is simple. I don’t believe in promoting a culture of blind faith by telling children dos and don’ts without them being mindful of what they do.

Recent findings suggest that free discussions and character building are the most important parts in religious upbringing. If someone is going to dedicate their life to pleasing Allah (swt), they need to do it for themselves.

They must find the motivation to do so within themselves. Being spoon-fed by well-intentioned parents often results in a shaky or even nonexistent connection to God.

My first interviewee, 17-year-old Aya, confided that she often feels “…hugely distanced from my parents because of the judgment I receive for doing things that I don’t, personally, find to be morally inappropriate.”.

Industry observers note that she knows her parents only intend to protect her, but the badgering is tiresome. More importantly, however, she feels their relationship tarnished by the occasional yet serious argument caused by harmless actions.

According to recent reports, salma, age 15, takes a similar stance on the issue. She also feels judged for making her own decisions if they happen to conflict with the beliefs of her parents.

When asked if she thinks her parents respect her personal opinions concerning religious rules, she responded:.

“Overall, no. Generally speaking, it’s if you disagree with someone’s opinion, you’re somehow disrespecting God, so there’s this mesh of opinion, interpretation, and actual religious rulings. Even if they don’t respect it, however,” she continued, “I still believe that I have the freedom to have my own opinions.”.

Recent findings suggest that salma says the judgement from her family has accomplished nothing but cause her to resent Islamic culture. This is, of course, the opposite of the intended impact and Salam recognizes that. She clarified that her perception of Islam is overall a positive one despite having to cope with critial behavior.

What makes her feel the most misunderstood? Salma replied: “Literally anything about young Muslims ‘straying off the right path.’ It bothers me how severely my parents simplify everyone’s situation to good and bad. There are so many different factors and reasons behind every action.”.

In a recent development, aya, was born into an Islamic household with a convert father. She acknowledges and respects her parents’ opinions but wishes they wouldn’t enforce them quite as strongly.

Recent findings suggest that the teen also observed that her father has somewhat ironically far higher standards for her behavior than her mother does. She marveled, “It’s weird because you’d think if anyone would be able to empathize with the complications of being pressured into a religion you’re not a thousand percent on board with, it would be a convert!”.

Aya also echoes Salma’s thoughts in regards to needing to feel liberated enough to form and voice her own views.

Sources indicate that “I’m old enough to form my own opinions,” Aya asserted. “My parents taught me right from wrong. I’d appreciate it if my parents would allow me to exercise the right to make my own decisions, especially ones that literally only affect me.”.

The interviewees commonly find their parents overbearing and rigidly dedicated to their personal mindsets.

Recent findings suggest that mariam, age 16, skillfully articulated their mutual struggle. “I wish my parents would phrase their beliefs as just that–their beliefs–not facts. More often than not, I agree with them, but it can be frustrating when they won’t accept any other viewpoints.”.

Hussain, an 18-year-old who recently moved out, is experiencing the kind of freedom one can only achieve by getting some distance from parents.

Sources indicate that he shared his views on how raising Muslim teenagers has become incredibly challenging for both parties. Hussain cautioned: “It’s difficult because of the current culture and the plethora of information out there sharing different ideas and ways of thinking.”.

All four teenagers offered unique insights but simultaneously share many experiences when it comes to their upbringing and the challenges that came along with it.

Industry observers note that my interviewees and I recognize that parenthood is an incredibly complex journey we haven’t embarked on ourselves. There’s no handbook of rules and no master to guide you through every decision, insuring that you never miscalculate a situation.

Many of the girls I spoke with admitted that they fully expect to make some of the same mistakes they observe their parents making when, inshaAllah, they have kids of their own one day.

This article is from our archive, originally published on an earlier date, and highlighted now for its importance.

Juri Ardiantoro Resmi Ditetapkan sebagai Ketua Umum PB IKA-PMII periode 2025–2030

💡 Key Takeaways

  • JAKARTA – Rapat Pleno Pengurus Besar Ikatan Alumni Pergerakan Mahasiswa Islam Indonesia (PB IKA-PMII) secara resmi menetapkan dan mengesahkan Sahabat Juri Ardiantoro sebagai Ketua Umum PB IKA-PMII periode 2025–2030.
  • Recent findings suggest that pleno ini dilaksanakan setelah Ketua Umum sebelumnya, Sahabat Fathan Subchi, berpulang pada 25 Oktober 2026.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, JAKARTA – Rapat Pleno Pengurus Besar Ikatan Alumni Pergerakan Mahasiswa Islam Indonesia (PB IKA-PMII) secara resmi menetapkan dan mengesahkan Sahabat Juri Ardiantoro sebagai Ketua Umum PB IKA-PMII periode 2025–2030. Pleno digelar di Sekretariat PB IKA PMII, Jalan Mandala IV No. 31, Menteng Dalam, Tebet, Jakarta Selatan. Pleno ini dilaksanakan setelah Ketua Umum sebelumnya, Sahabat Fathan Subchi, berpulang pada 25 Oktober 2026. Untuk menjamin keberlangsungan roda organisasi, pleno digelar guna mengisi kekosongan kepemimpinan sesuai mekanisme organisasi. Baca Juga Pertamina Patra Niaga dan Pemerintah Resmikan SPBUN Rokan Hilir, Dukung Ekonomi Masyarakat Pesisir Perkuat Nilai Tukar Rupiah Bank Indonesia Naikkan BI Rate Jadi 6 Persen Porprov VII Banten Menjaring Talenta Esports Masa Depan Rapat dihadiri oleh Majelis Pertimbangan Organisasi, Dewan Pakar, Badan Pengurus Harian, serta pengurus Lembaga dan Departemen PB IKA PMII. Sidang dipimpin oleh Asrorun Niam Sholeh selaku pimpinan sidang, dengan Muhammad Nur Purnamasidi sebagai Sekretaris sidang. Dalam forum tersebut, pimpinan sidang menegaskan “Pleno ini adalah ikhtiar organisasi untuk memastikan kepemimpinan PB IKA PMII tetap berjalan setelah wafatnya Sahabat Fathan Subchi. Seluruh proses telah kami laksanakan secara musyawarah, sesuai mekanisme organisasi, dan dengan dukungan para peserta pleno. Kami meyakini Sahabat Juri Ardiantoro memiliki kapasitas dan pengalaman untuk melanjutkan amanah ini. Semoga almarhum Sahabat Fathan Subchi husnul khatimah, dan kepemimpinan yang baru membawa IKA-PMII semakin berkhidmat bagi umat, bangsa, dan organisasi.” Gayung bersambut, dalam sambutan perdananya setelah ditetapkan, Juri Ardiantoro menyampaikan rasa haru atas kepercayaan yang diberikan kepadanya. “Saya terharu dan mengucapkan terima kasih atas kepercayaan sahabat-sahabat sekalian. Amanah ini tidak ringan, apalagi kita semua baru saja kehilangan Sahabat Fathan Subchi. Saya tidak mungkin berjalan sendiri, karena itu saya memohon support dan dukungan dari seluruh keluarga besar IKA-PMII, baik pengurus besar, wilayah, cabang maupun para alumni di seluruh Indonesia,” ujarnya. Ia menegaskan bahwa PB IKA-PMII harus bergerak melalui kerja-kerja strategis, bukan sekadar menjalankan rutinitas organisasi. “PB IKA PMII tidak boleh hanya sibuk dengan agenda seremonial. Kita harus melakukan kerja-kerja strategis yang manfaatnya benar-benar dirasakan oleh alumni, oleh organisasi, dan oleh masyarakat luas. Kader dan alumni PMII punya modal sosial dan jaringan yang besar, dan itu harus kita arahkan secara terukur,” tegasnya. Sebelum forum di tutup, Ketua Umum Juri Ardiantoro bersama jajaran pengurus berkomitmen menjalankan amanah kepengurusan yang dapat membawa manfaat, perubahan organisasi, dan keberlanjutan. “Mari kita pasang niat berkhidmat yang membawa manfaat, perubahan, dan berkelanjutan untuk organisasi tercinta kita ini.” Ikuti Whatsapp Channel Republika.

Ia menegaskan bahwa PB IKA-PMII harus bergerak melalui kerja-kerja strategis, bukan sekadar menjalankan rutinitas organisasi. “PB IKA PMII tidak boleh hanya sibuk dengan agenda seremonial. Kita harus melakukan kerja-kerja strategis yang manfaatnya benar-benar dirasakan oleh alumni, oleh organisasi, dan oleh masyarakat luas. Kader dan alumni PMII punya modal sosial dan jaringan yang besar, dan itu harus kita arahkan secara terukur,” tegasnya. Sebelum forum di tutup, Ketua Umum Juri Ardiantoro bersama jajaran pengurus berkomitmen menjalankan amanah kepengurusan yang dapat membawa manfaat, perubahan organisasi, dan keberlanjutan. “Mari kita pasang niat berkhidmat yang membawa manfaat, perubahan, dan berkelanjutan untuk organisasi tercinta kita ini.” Ikuti Whatsapp Channel Republika.

#4. Arab Saudi Luncurkan Sistem Ufuq untuk Dukung Pengambilan Keputusan Layanan Haji dan Umrah

📅 18 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 14m • 📚 Deep Dive (2735 w)

Arab Saudi Luncurkan Sistem Ufuq untuk Dukung Pengambilan Keputusan Layanan Haji dan Umrah

📅 18 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 14 min read (2735 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~14 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • RIYADH -- Pemerintah Arab Saudi resmi meluncurkan sistem digital bernama "Ufuq" yang dirancang untuk mengoptimalkan pemanfaatan data di sektor haji dan umrah.
  • It has been revealed that RIYADH -- Pemerintah Arab Saudi resmi meluncurkan sistem digital bernama "Ufuq" yang dirancang untuk mengoptimalkan pemanfaatan data di sektor haji dan umrah.
  • Dilansir dari Arab News, Rabu (11/11/2026), peluncuran dilakukan langsung oleh Menteri Haji dan Umrah sekaligus Ketua Komite Program Pengalaman Jamaah (Pilgrim Experience Program/PEP), Tawfiq Al-Rabiah.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

RIYADH -- Pemerintah Arab Saudi resmi meluncurkan sistem digital bernama "Ufuq" yang dirancang untuk mengoptimalkan pemanfaatan data di sektor haji dan umrah. Sistem ini mengubah tumpukan data lapangan menjadi perangkat berbasis pengetahuan guna mendukung ketepatan pengambilan keputusan oleh para pemangku kebijakan. Dilansir dari Arab News, Rabu (11/11/2026), peluncuran dilakukan langsung oleh Menteri Haji dan Umrah sekaligus Ketua Komite Program Pengalaman Jamaah (Pilgrim Experience Program/PEP), Tawfiq Al-Rabiah. Baca Juga UBSI dan Ciputra Jajaki Kolaborasi Sediakan Program Magang Opsi Kereta Baru untuk Warga Bogor ke Jakarta, KA Bandara Tarif Parsial Mulai Rp35 Ribu Foto Gibran Belum Diturunkan di Sekolah-Sekolah Bogor, Ini Penjelasannya Peresmian berlangsung di paviliun PEP dalam rangkaian Konferensi dan Pameran Haji dan Umrah keenam di Jeddah yang resmi ditutup pada hari yang sama. Pihak PEP menjelaskan, kehadiran Ufuq merupakan langkah strategis untuk memudahkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan mengakses dan memanfaatkan data sektor perhajian secara menyeluruh. Pendekatan yang diusung tidak sekadar menyajikan angka statistik, melainkan mengolahnya menjadi rujukan kebijakan berbasis data. Dalam pengoperasiannya, sistem Ufuq memuat lebih dari 100 laporan tahunan khusus sektor haji dan umrah, dilengkapi dengan lebih dari 15 panel informasi interaktif. Fasilitas ini memungkinkan berbagai instansi pemerintah memantau indikator layanan secara presisi untuk merumuskan perencanaan yang lebih matang. Tercatat lebih dari 55 lembaga pemerintah di Arab Saudi akan terhubung dan memanfaatkan produk data dari Ufuq. Langkah ini ditempuh dalam kerangka memperkuat integrasi serta pertukaran informasi antarinstansi yang terlibat langsung dalam ekosistem pelayanan tamu Allah. Selain itu, melalui platform data terbuka nasional, Ufuq turut menyediakan lebih dari 15 himpunan data terbuka (open datasets) bernilai tinggi. Ekosistem layanan yang mencakup laporan, dasbor pemantauan, hingga perangkat proyeksi masa depan tersebut dikemas di bawah tema besar "Data Beyond Numbers" (Data Melampaui Angka). Peluncuran Ufuq menjadi bagian dari upaya berkelanjutan PEP dalam mewujudkan target besar Visi Saudi 2030. Program ini bertujuan memfasilitasi sebanyak mungkin umat Islam dari seluruh dunia agar dapat menunaikan ibadah haji dan umrah dengan kualitas pelayanan terbaik. PEP secara konsisten berupaya menghadirkan pengalaman spiritual yang berkesan bagi jamaah dengan menata kesiapan layanan di Dua Tanah Suci (Haramain), yakni Masjidil Haram di Makkah dan Masjid Nabawi di Madinah. Cakupannya meliputi persiapan destinasi budaya hingga jaminan mutu layanan sebelum, selama, dan setelah jamaah berkunjung ke Tanah Suci. Sebelumnya, saat berbicara dalam sesi diskusi bertajuk "Melayani Tamu Allah: Sistem Nasional Terpadu" pada Senin (9/11/2026), Tawfiq Al-Rabiah memaparkan bahwa PEP yang diluncurkan sejak 2019 telah membawa transformasi besar dalam manajemen perjalanan ibadah. Transformasi itu mencakup kemudahan akses menuju Dua Tanah Suci hingga peningkatan kualitas layanan keagamaan dan budaya. Al-Rabiah juga mengungkapkan lonjakan signifikan jumlah jamaah umrah dari luar negeri, yakni meningkat dari 8,4 juta orang pada 2022 menjadi 18 juta orang pada 2025. Pada periode yang sama, jumlah peziarah yang berkunjung ke kawasan suci Raudhah di dalam Masjid Nabawi, Madinah, turut melonjak drastis dari 6 juta menjadi sekitar 16 juta orang. Sumber: Arab News   Ikuti Whatsapp Channel Republika.

PEP secara konsisten berupaya menghadirkan pengalaman spiritual yang berkesan bagi jamaah dengan menata kesiapan layanan di Dua Tanah Suci (Haramain), yakni Masjidil Haram di Makkah dan Masjid Nabawi di Madinah. Cakupannya meliputi persiapan destinasi budaya hingga jaminan mutu layanan sebelum, selama, dan setelah jamaah berkunjung ke Tanah Suci. Sebelumnya, saat berbicara dalam sesi diskusi bertajuk "Melayani Tamu Allah: Sistem Nasional Terpadu" pada Senin (9/11/2026), Tawfiq Al-Rabiah memaparkan bahwa PEP yang diluncurkan sejak 2019 telah membawa transformasi besar dalam manajemen perjalanan ibadah. Transformasi itu mencakup kemudahan akses menuju Dua Tanah Suci hingga peningkatan kualitas layanan keagamaan dan budaya. Al-Rabiah juga mengungkapkan lonjakan signifikan jumlah jamaah umrah dari luar negeri, yakni meningkat dari 8,4 juta orang pada 2022 menjadi 18 juta orang pada 2025. Pada periode yang sama, jumlah peziarah yang berkunjung ke kawasan suci Raudhah di dalam Masjid Nabawi, Madinah, turut melonjak drastis dari 6 juta menjadi sekitar 16 juta orang. Mengenal Deretan Tokoh Muslim dan Arab yang Baru Terpilih Jadi Pejabat di Dearborn AS

  • DEARBORN -- Malam pemilihan paruh waktu (midterms) di Amerika Serikat pada 3 November lalu menjadi momen bersejarah bagi komunitas Arab dan Muslim di tenggara negara bagian Michigan.
